rows.en: Go, don't die! I don't want you to die, Go!!

"Hideki Go… I witnessed your brave actions.

I was moved by how you tried to save a child with no thought for your own danger.

In my present form, I cannot remain on Earth. So, I entrust my life to you…

Let us work together for the peace of Earth and the freedom of humankind…"
Captain…!
…What is it?
Go… They say Officer Go has come back to life!
What!?
What's wrong, [HERO4]? Why the long face?
Well… The command satellite's survey data shows another high energy reading…

What!?

Then… has Destron made a cyborg like Takeshi and the others?
No, this one's different. It's certainly a high energy reading, but not as high as with Hongo, Hayato or Kazami…
It's about the same reading as when Goro transforms.

Huh?

Then… you're saying there's another mutant like me?
I don't know… But it does seem certain that something close to that exists.
Friend or foe? Which is it?
Captain Salah hasn't told me about any new Boys' League member. In that case…
Hey… The TDF has a missing-person case for you lot.

A missing person?

Like some professor who's lost his memory or something?

This is no time for jokes!

From what I hear… the person's a mutant!
A mutant?
You mean… Goro?
Huh!?

No, no… Seems that's not it.

From what I hear… it's a patient being treated at the TDF Hospital.
Then… isn't that a job for the police, not us?
Hmm… I thought so too, but something about the story doesn't add up…
Could the TDF be hiding something?
Surely not!? They wouldn't…
That man is Jimmy Kitahara!

Oh?

What's this, all of you together? Some big incident?
He's a man who miraculously came back alive after 15 years. From space…
From space?

Jimmy Kitahara was a former SIDO space engineer who left Earth 15 years ago to investigate Number Ten…

But the space fortress ship he was aboard vanished in an accident of unknown cause.
Ever since, the Galactic Union Police had also been investigating his whereabouts…

And then…

Alan, the Space Sheriff in charge of that sector, rescued a lifeboat drifting near Uranus, and after 15 years Jimmy Kitahara returned to SIDO… I mean, to what is now the TDF.

So… he was admitted to the TDF Hospital to have his health checked…

What? That's good news, isn't it! What's the incident in that?

According to Alan, who rescued Jimmy Kitahara…

he was alone in the lifeboat… and what's more, amazingly, he hadn't grown any older in those 15 years.
In other words… he hadn't aged?
That's right…
Impossible!? That's…
No way!? But that's kinda… enviable, maybe?
Most likely… Jimmy Kitahara passed through a space-time tunnel.

In that case…

although 15 years passed in Earth time, for him, traveling faster than light, it may have been less than a year.
…So what does the TDF say?

It's a strange story…

Everything about Number Ten and about Jimmy Kitahara is classified, and they won't tell even the Galactic Union Police anything.

It bothered me, so I looked for the investigation files from 15 years ago…

but there's no record of any information on this case at all…
Commander Kom says that with this, there's no way to look into it…
So he's the mutant in question…
So he's the missing mutant?

And the other problem is…

Makuu, Madou and Fuuma are all after this Jimmy Kitahara!
Probably… there's some secret tied to his being a mutant!
Either way, we can't just leave it! We have to get him to safety before they do, whatever it takes…
It's around here. Where the command satellite's survey data showed the energy reading…
I can sense it around here. The same feeling as Goro…
Makuu, Madou and Fuuma, all of them!?
I knew it… Jimmy Kitahara is somewhere near here.
Captain! A kaiju has appeared near the offshore oil plant!

What!?

Right, prepare to sortie!!
Captain, let me handle it!
Go, can you handle it alone? Is your body all right now?
I'm fine, leave it to me! If I aim carefully, one shot will do it.
Captain! Let Go try using the X Shell.
What's that?
It's an Ultra Rocket we only finished yesterday, Kishida's idea!
Against a kaiju like that… I think it'll probably be blown away without a trace.
The X Shell's that powerful?
It's my hard-won rocket shell!

All right, then it's a sure thing! Go's marksmanship plus Kishida's X Shell, that's unbeatable…

And I'll get my day off today as planned! All right, I'll go along too! That way I'll get back sooner…

All right, Minami, Go… go!!

But we only have two X Shells! Get as close as you can before you fire! Understood?
Understood, Captain! Just relax and watch…
Real combat isn't the firing range! Don't take it lightly…
Leave it to me!
This guy… is awfully sure of himself, isn't he?

Carry out the operation calmly and coolly, and work together!

Go… you rose from the ashes like a phoenix! I'm counting on that indomitable spirit and strength of yours from here on!
Yes, sir!
That's MAT!?
That's MAT!?
That's MAT!?
MAT?

Yeah… the Monster Attack Team, known as MAT.

An organization like the TDF's Ultra Garrison or the Science Patrol.

A special team in the TDF's Earth defense forces that takes on every kind of strange incident to protect the peace of Earth…

I hear they're kaiju-busting specialists, an elite unit made up of Captain Kato and five others.
